name: color-slider
description: A color slider lets users visually change an individual channel of a color.

documentBlocks.content: A color slider lets users visually change an individual channel of a color.

Keyboard focus.

The keyboard focus state enlarges the handle to become twice as large. The loupe is a visual-only element and should not receive focus since it does not provide interactive functionality.

Handle behavior.

Unlike the slider itself, the color slider's handle can slide all the way to the edge of the track. It always displays the selected color inside the handle and never gets cut off by the track or any container.

Minimum length.

A color slider's minimum length is 80 px on desktop, 100 px on mobile.

Include labels.

Color sliders should be labeled and, when applicable, paired with text fields. If labeling each individual slider is redundant, label the group of sliders instead (for example, "RGB" or "HSB").

Display color selection.

When using color sliders, it's important to clearly display the color selection in real time. It can be in a color swatch, directly on the canvas, or both.

Color loupe on down/touch state.

The color loupe component can be used above the handle to show the selected color that would otherwise be covered by a cursor, stylus, or finger on the down/touch state. This can be customized to appear only on finger-input, or always appear regardless of input type.

channel.description: Which channel of the color this slider controls. Use 'alpha' for opacity.

label.description: The field label text (Figma Show label, RSP label).

color.description: The color whose channel the slider adjusts (S2 value). The gradient ramp is computed from it and the channel. Accepts a CSS color string: #rgb, #rgba, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa, rgb(), rgba(), hsl(), hsla(), hsb(), hsba() or transparent (the forms the ramp engine parses).

colorSpace.description: The color space the channel belongs to (S2 colorSpace). Defaults to the color's own space.

constraints.description: The rgb color space has the red, green, blue and alpha channels.
The hsl color space has the hue, saturation, lightness and alpha channels.
The hsb color space has the hue, saturation, brightness and alpha channels.

anatomy.name: container
anatomy.description: Root: owns the slider's length and minimum length.

anatomy.name: field-label
anatomy.description: The field label component above the track (Figma Field label instance, RSP FieldLabel).

anatomy.name: value
anatomy.description: Current channel value shown beside the label.

anatomy.name: track
anatomy.description: Track holding the checkerboard, the gradient and the handle; owns thickness, border, radius and the disabled background.

anatomy.name: opacity-checkerboard
anatomy.description: Checkerboard behind the gradient so an opacity channel reads. Absent when disabled (Figma); sized m.

anatomy.name: fill
anatomy.description: The channel gradient drawn over the checkerboard (Figma Color slider fill). Owner decision C5.

anatomy.name: color-handle
anatomy.description: Handle marking the selected channel value.

anatomyReview.notes: A7 (2026-11-20). RSP ColorSlider.tsx:89-156 (handle grows on focus, track draws no ring; label and output over the track); Figma Color slider (Field label, Value, Opacity checkerboard, Color slider fill, border, .Color slider track holding a Color handle). Explicit container added. Owner decision C5: the gradient is a fill part inside track. Option background dropped (no source has it). Owner decision C6: the label part is field-label (the nested field-label component). R4b (interim): the checkerboard and fill are also listed under container because the recipe stacks them in the root; the engine allows stack only on a root box. Remove those two entries from container.contains once stack is allowed on a non-root box.
